rules.name: Greeting & Introduction
rules.replyText:
Welcome to IndiaSpare.com (Zero213 Ventures)! 🚗⚙️

Your trusted supplier for genuine automotive & industrial spare parts with all-India express delivery.

How can our technical sales team assist you today?
• Reply *PART* to check spare availability & fitment
• Reply *TRACK* to check order status
• Reply *AGENT* to speak directly with an executive.

rules.name: Spare Parts & Fitment Inquiry
rules.replyText:
Looking for a specific spare part? 🔧

Please share:
1. *Vehicle / Machine Model* (e.g. Mahindra Bolero, Maruti Swift, JCB 3DX, Tata Ace)
2. *Part Name or OEM Part Number*
3. *Photo of old part* (optional)

Our technical team will check warehouse stock and send you an instant quotation with GST invoice details!

rules.replyText:
